description: Partial coverage (L6 target form). A section left out of the view, or a details block a brief view condenses, holds a danger the view carries (L1). The omission says which of its lines were carried and where they appear in the view, so the omission and the source map agree. (A budget never omits a section that holds a danger, so the budget case has no carried lines to record.)

requests.name: section Work records which lines of the sections it leaves out it carried
a brief view records the danger it carries out of the condensed details
